attchmntText: Atal Realtech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Atal Realtech Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The board meeting was held on 14th November 2026. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, the company reported a profit before tax of 349.80 lakhs and a net profit of 256.36 lakhs. Revenue from operations stood at 3,458.20 lakhs. Total assets were 13,083.40 lakhs as at 30th September 2026, compared to 11,885.91 lakhs as at 31st March 2026. Basic earnings per share was 0.21 for the half year. The results were reviewed by auditors Sharpaarth & Co LLP, who reported no material misstatements. Managing Director Vijaygopal Parasram Atal signed the disclosure.
